title: Didn't completely seal my bag and I left it on longer than required.
text:
Didn't completely seal my bag and I left it on longer than required.. This Bag Sealer is not too impressive. I used it on a bag of potato chips. The next day I checked the bag. The bag opened in spots with a light tug to see how well it was sealed.

The sealer heats up pretty fast. The instructions say to leave the heat on the bag for 1-3 seconds for each half of the bag. I left mine on longer but didn't completely seal my bag of chips. I am trying it on another bag and I will revise my review if the results are different.

I will not be recommending this Bag Sealer to family and friends.
